title: 지정재판부의 구성과 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the composition and operation of Panels responsible for the prior review of constitutional complaints pursuant to Article 72 (6) of the Constitutional Court Act. <Amended on December 3, 1991>
